Offline Donations Test Guide

How the dashboard handles a donation recorded by hand (cash, cheque, bank transfer or Interac e-Transfer). Of the donor, only the name is required, but the money needs its proof: a cheque its number and both photos, a transfer its reference. A new donor who looks like someone already on file is shown before being created. Offline gifts are marked and can be filtered and exported. Each one opens a details window with the donor's contact, the cheque photos, the edit history and an Edit button. Each case has steps, the expected result and a screenshot of the expected screen.

Before you start

Set up the test environment

The new screens need the backend PR deployed to the backend the build calls, and the offline donations flag on.

Builds

  • Frontend: the preview of the frontend PR above.
  • Backend: the backend PR deployed with its migrations run: a new table keeps the edit history.
  • A queue worker running: the event total moves through a queued job after an edit.

Accounts

  • Admin A: all permissions (an owner works).
  • Admin B: a role with view PaymentGateway but without manage DonationReceipt.
  • A donor with their own account on the website (signed up, has a password).

Data

  • A published event and a published program, both in CAD.
  • Two photos to use as a cheque front and back (any JPG or PNG under 10 MB).
  • For the receipt cases: tax receipting set up for the organisation (Settings, receipting).

Feature flag (Netlify, then rebuild)

NEXT_PUBLIC_OFFLINE_DONATIONS=true

With the flag off nothing of this guide shows: no Record button, no Payment filter, no details window.

Recording

OF-1

Record a cheque for a new donor known only by name

Manual

A walk-in donor often leaves only a name: email, phone and address are optional. The cheque itself is not: its number and a photo of each side are required.

Steps

  1. Donations → Record offline donation.
  2. Payment method Cheque, amount 250, cheque number 001042.
  3. Upload a cheque front and back.
  4. Donation for → Event → pick an event.
  5. Donor → New donor: type a full name and a phone such as +1 (416) 555-0123. Leave email and address empty.
  6. Leave "Issue a tax receipt after recording" unticked (it starts unticked) and press Record donation.

Expected

  • Email, Phone and the address fields say optional. Amount, Date received, Cheque number, Cheque front, Cheque back, Donation for, Donor and Full name carry a red star.
  • Currency offers CAD only once #1895 is merged too.
  • "Offline donation recorded." and the gift appears at the top of Recent Donations.
  • Searching "Existing donor" by part of the phone (for example 555-01) finds this donor next time.
  • If someone with the same name or phone is already on file, the form shows them first: see OF-13.
OF-2

What the form still asks for

Manual

Steps

  1. Open Record offline donation, choose New donor, press Record without typing anything.
  2. Type nope as the email, or call me as the phone, and press Record.
  3. Tick "Issue a tax receipt after recording" with no address.

Expected

  • With the default method (Cash), three messages only: amount, event or program, and the donor's name. Nothing about the email or a reference. The proof each other method needs is in OF-12.
  • A malformed email or phone is refused ("Enter a valid … or leave it empty").
  • With the receipt ticked, address, city and postal code become required: a receipt cannot be issued without them.
OF-12

Proof of payment per method, e-Transfer included

Manual

Money that arrives by cheque or transfer needs its proof on file. The same rules apply when the donation is edited.

Steps

  1. Open Record offline donation and open the Payment method list.
  2. Choose Cheque, fill amount, a program and a donor, and press Record without a number or photos. Then add only the front photo and press Record again.
  3. Choose Interac e-Transfer and press Record without a reference; then type one (for example ET-1001) and record.
  4. Do the same with Bank transfer.
  5. Choose Cash and record with the reference left empty.
  6. Open a recorded cheque gift, press Edit, remove one photo or clear the number, and press Save changes.

Expected

  • The methods are Cash, Cheque, Bank transfer and Interac e-Transfer.
  • Cheque: "Enter the cheque number.", plus "Upload a photo of the front/back of the cheque." for each missing side. Nothing is recorded until all three are there.
  • e-Transfer and bank transfer: "Enter the transfer reference." until one is typed; then the gift records with the badge Offline · Interac e-Transfer (or Bank transfer).
  • Cash records with no reference.
  • Edit refuses the same missing proof; switching a cheque to Cash drops the photos and needs no number.
OF-13

A new donor who may already be on file

Manual

Typing a regular donor in as "New donor" would create a second record for the same person. Before creating one, the form shows anyone with the same full name or the same phone number.

Steps

  1. Record a gift for a new donor, for example Mona Fahmy with phone 647 555 0188.
  2. Record another gift, choose New donor and type mona fahmy (other letter case, extra spaces). Press Record.
  3. Press Use this donor, then Record.
  4. Repeat step 2, this time with a different name and the phone +1 647-555-0188, and press Create a new donor anyway.
  5. Repeat step 2 with only the same first name (Mona Salem) and no phone.

Expected

  • Step 2: nothing is recorded yet. An amber box "This donor may already be in your list" lists Mona Fahmy with her email (or "No email") and phone.
  • Use this donor switches the form to Existing donor with her picked; Record then saves the gift on her record, and no second Mona is created.
  • The same phone, with or without +1, shows the warning too. Create a new donor anyway records the gift for a new person straight away.
  • The same first name alone, or a short part of a phone, does not trigger the warning.
  • Changing the donor's name or switching to Existing donor hides the box.

Finding offline donations

OF-3

Offline badge in the donations list

Manual

Steps

  1. Look at Recent Donations on the Donations page, and on View All.

Expected

  • An offline gift shows an amber Offline · Cheque (or Cash, Bank transfer, Interac e-Transfer) badge in the Status column instead of "Succeeded".
  • Online gifts keep their usual status badge.
OF-4

Show only offline donations

Manual

Steps

  1. Next to Donation Category, open Payment and pick Offline.
  2. Reload the page, then pick Online, then All.

Expected

  • Offline: every row is an offline gift, and the cards, the trends chart, Top Donors and the aggregations count offline gifts only.
  • The choice is kept in the address (?channel=offline) and survives a reload and View All.
  • Online hides the offline gifts; All shows everything.
Dashboard · Offline donation window

Details and editing

OF-5

Open a donation's details and its cheque

Manual

Steps

  1. Click an offline row (anywhere except its buttons), or its eye button.
  2. Click a cheque photo.

Expected

  • The window shows the amount, the date received, the event or program, and the Offline badge.
  • Donor: name, email, phone (shown as +1 (416) 555-0123), address; empty fields show a dash.
  • Payment: method, cheque number, who recorded it and when, the internal note, the receipt status.
  • Cheque photos: both sides; a click shows the photo large, with a link to open the original in a new tab.
  • Edit history: "No changes since it was recorded." until the gift is edited (see OF-14).
  • Clicking an online row does nothing new.
OF-6

Edit an offline donation

Manual

Everything can be corrected, the amount, date and event or program included. The donor stays the same person.

Steps

  1. In the details window press Edit.
  2. Change the amount from 250 to 300 and add an email.
  3. Press Save changes.
  4. Try again: clear the email, switch the method to Cash, change the event to a program.

Expected

  • The form opens filled with what was recorded, photos included.
  • "Donation updated." and the window shows CAD 300.00 and the new email; the list behind it updates.
  • A cleared field is cleared; switching to Cash drops the photos; the gift moves to the program.
  • Each save that changes something adds an entry to the Edit history (OF-14).
OF-14

Edit history: who changed what, and when

Manual

Recorded-by and the last-updated time are not enough for money: every correction keeps who made it, when, and each changed value before and after.

Steps

  1. Open an offline gift that was never edited.
  2. Edit it: change the amount and the donor's city, and save.
  3. Edit it again: change the event or program, and save.
  4. Open Edit and press Save changes without changing anything.
  5. For a cheque gift, replace one photo and save.

Expected

  • Before any edit: "No changes since it was recorded."
  • Each save adds an entry at the top: "admin name on date, time", then only the fields that changed, as old → new. For example Amount CAD 80.00 → CAD 95.00, City — → Toronto.
  • A move shows "Donation for" with the old and new event or program by name.
  • Saving without a change adds no entry.
  • A replaced photo reads "Photo → New photo"; a removed one "Photo → Removed". The photo files themselves are not shown in the history.
OF-7

A donor with their own account is read-only

Needs setup

Only a donor created from this form, who never signed up, can have their details changed here. A person with an account owns their details.

Steps

  1. Record an offline gift for the donor with an account (Existing donor → search).
  2. Open its details, then Edit.

Expected

  • Details show a Has an account tag next to the name.
  • Edit shows the donor locked, with "only they can change their details"; the rest of the donation can still be changed.
  • If that donor has no address on file, the receipt checkbox is replaced by a note saying the address is needed first.
OF-9

Editing a donation that has a tax receipt

Needs setup

An issued receipt is never edited (CRA rule): it is cancelled and replaced, or flagged for someone to decide.

Steps

  1. With receipting set up, record a gift with "Issue a tax receipt" ticked (address required) and wait until the receipt shows as issued.
  2. Edit it and change only the note.
  3. Edit it and change the amount.
  4. Edit it and move the date to last year.
  5. Edit a gift that has no receipt and tick "Issue a tax receipt for this donation".

Expected

  • Note only: "Donation updated.", the receipt is untouched.
  • Amount (or the donor's name or address): "…its tax receipt was cancelled and replaced…". The old receipt shows as cancelled, a new number is issued.
  • Date moved to another year: "…its tax receipt needs a correction…"; the receipt column offers cancel and replace.
  • While a receipt is still being generated, or its generation failed, a change that touches it is refused with a message to wait or retry it first.
  • No receipt yet + ticked: "…its tax receipt is being generated."
OF-11

Event and program totals follow an edit

Manual

Steps

  1. Note the raised amount on the event's public page (or the event in the dashboard).
  2. Edit an offline gift for that event from 250 to 300, then move it to a program.

Expected

  • After the first edit the event total goes up by 50; after the move it goes down by 300 and the program's total goes up by 300.
  • Done by a queued job: allow a few seconds.

Checked locally: after editing 250 → 300 → 250 → 300 the event's raised total equalled the sum of its payments each time.

OF-10

Only receipt managers open the details

Needs setup

Steps

  1. Sign in as Admin B (no manage DonationReceipt) and open Donations.

Expected

  • Offline rows still show the Offline badge and the Payment filter works.
  • No eye button, and clicking an offline row opens nothing: the details show the donor's contact and the cheque, so they follow the same permission as recording.
  • No Record offline donation button.

Export

OF-8

Export with the offline columns

Manual

Steps

  1. View All, set Payment to Offline.
  2. Export CSV, then Export XLSX.

Expected

  • Only offline gifts are in the files.
  • The usual columns first, then six new ones at the end. CSV: Payment, Payment method, Payment reference, Donor phone, Internal note, Recorded by. XLSX: channel, payment_method, payment_reference, donor_phone, note, recorded_by.
  • For online gifts those columns read Online and are otherwise empty.
